summary: Read-only inspection; nothing was changed. Loaded the bare URL and let it settle — Grafana itself rewrote the address bar to add the stored defaults, so (1) the URL exactly as shown is http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/ffz989fhtrqioa/fwgr73-n1-bench-dashboard?from=now-6h&to=now&timezone=browser&refresh=1m. (2) The page header shows the dashboard title 'fwgr73-n1 Bench Dashboard'. (3) The dashboard has exactly two panels: 'fwgr73-n1 Notes' (text body "Notes for run fwgr73-n1") and 'fwgr73-n1 Availability' (Stat, value 47.5). (4) Top bar: time range "Last 6 hours" and refresh interval "1m" (aria-label "Choose refresh time interval with current interval 1 minute selected"). (5) Dashboard settings > General > Tags lists a single tag chip, 'bench' (Remove "bench" tag). To reach General I had to go through Edit > Settings (Grafana's normal route); I made no edits and clicked "Exit edit", which returned to view mode with no unsaved-changes prompt, confirming nothing was modified.
